corruption.configuration.title: Corruption Configuration
corruption.configuration.infection.sower: Enabled by default: the ground the corrupted sower takes underfoot keeps the block's own corrupted variant and hurts as any corruption does, but never spreads the infection on from there. Disabled, it spreads as ordinary corruption does. Dormant ground is marked by position, so no second variant is generated for each block.
corruption.configuration.blocks.corrupte: Disabled by default. When enabled, generated corrupted solid variants burn and spread fire. Corruption, malice, special ores, fluids and plants retain their own fire rules.
corruption.configuration.infection.enabl: Master switch for block infection. Pauses discovery and conversions; re-enabling resumes spread.
corruption.configuration.demons.arcaneOn: Enabled by default: the Goetic demons can be hurt only by spells, damage types in the tag corruption:spell, or a blow with a blade that bears the arcane's mark. /kill and the void always reach them. Disabled, any damage hurts them.
